bio.text: Damon Galdo is the Republican nominee for New Jersey's 1st Congressional District, where he is challenging Democratic Rep. Donald Norcross.
Galdo, 45, is a construction superintendent from West Deptford.
He unsuccessfully sought the Republican nomination in 2022 and 2024, according to WHYY.

sources.title: New Jersey election 2026: What to know about the 1st Congressional District race between Donald Norcross and Damon Galdo
